claim_type_findings.successor_rescue_laundering_boundary: A successor may be motivated by prior development results, but may not reuse the same object/identity or silently revise the exposed contract to make the prior result succeed.

prospective_recommendations: Add development_phase as an orthogonal canonical field for every active/development object: OPEN_DEVELOPMENT, RESULT_EXPOSED_DEVELOPMENT, or CONSUMED_ONE_WAY; do not encode it inside hold_class, terminal_state, queue_state, eligibility or READY.
At cycle 3, require a recorded reassessment with next-cycle information_gain, change_class and stop/continue rationale; do not auto-terminalize solely because cycle_count reached three.

Allow same-object SCIENCE_INVARIANT_REPAIR in OPEN_DEVELOPMENT and RESULT_EXPOSED_DEVELOPMENT with durable before/after code and result provenance; never count repaired/repeated development runs as independent confirmation.

After meaningful result exposure, require SCIENCE_AFFECTING_CHANGE to create a versioned development revision or fresh successor preserving all prior results and the exact old contract; never silently overwrite metric, threshold, comparator, seed, intervention, privilege/resource, hypothesis, falsifier or success criteria.
Treat PRE_FORMAL as iterative development. READY should require only that the next PRE_FORMAL test is well-defined and informative; comparator/reduction/falsifier success is not a prerequisite.

Keep same-object SYSTEM to MECHANISM uplift prohibited, while allowing fresh MECHANISM successors with a new candidate ID, independently motivated residual/question, fresh prospective contracts and fresh development state.

Interpret TERMINAL_FOR_CURRENT_OBJECT literally as closure of that object/contract, not the phenomenon family. Fresh successor admission should distinguish new question/versioned development from rescue laundering rather than require topic amnesia.
Keep NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET denominator-excluded and non-evidentiary, but do not let repeated liveness checks become an implicit barrier to fresh successor/reframe proposals.
Do not reopen or rerun historical candidate32, candidate31, R33, PD01 or any consumed/terminal identity solely because HUMAN_005 changes prospective methodology.
Retain all existing strict FORMAL integrity and outstanding verifier/raw-preservation/protected-evaluation tightening.
